create_motor_model: create a MotorModel instance with custom kp and kd PD gains for position control
convert_to_torque: convert motor position commands or PWM signals to actual and observed torque values
set_motor_gains: set the proportional and derivative PD gains for all motors in the model
set_strength_ratios: set the relative strength ratios of each motor output from 0.0 to 1.0
set_voltage: set the motor voltage value used in torque calculations for the motor model
